description: MTA Staten Island Railway Scheduled Trips: Beginning 2006 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset includes the number of trips scheduled to run on the Staten Island Railway for different periods of time in each month based on the timetable in effect. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are scheduled service, service, subway, staten island railway, sir. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
